messages.subject: Questions with unmarkedFramePCO for applying Dial Madsen model
parts:
Hi,

I want to run Dial Madsen model for estimating abundance from my bird count data. But I am stuck with few questions and would appreciate any help in those questions.

Data:

I have 5 years of bird count data along the same transect and these surveys are done each year from july to august These are simple counts with no distance measured. The population is open for birth, immigration, emigration and death. So I decided to use Dial Madsen model for my analysis. 

R:

unmarkedFramePCO and PCountOpen can be used for this

covariates:

site: habitat characteristic
obs: temperature, precipitation

Problem:
pcountopen: 
I understand lambda is the initial abundance, gamma is growth rate which can be the difference between current year-previous year abundance for each transect, omega is survival probability or equilibrium abundance, p is detection probability which can be for each transect abundance for that transect/total abundance of that year?. But how am I going to calculate omega and also gamma for first year when I don;t have anydata to compare to. And these details will be calculated for each transect, so am I supposed to use their average in my model?

These are the basic questions but would really be glad if someone could answer it. Also if someone can reply with the links for useful examples. I came across few but more is always helpful.

Thanks,
Sprih
